eligibility.rule: tight = two-sided (0 < bid < ask < 1), spread <= 0.10 (Gamma spread, else ask - bid), mid in [0.02, 0.98]; origin eligibility = panel.eligibility_mask

e012.x: mid_i - mid_h, h = the capture 12 slots (24 h) before i, tight at h; NaN otherwise
e012.y: mid_j - mid_i, j = the capture 12 slots after i, two-sided at j (panel.target_valid)

econ.illiquid: L == 0 (volume24hr zero or missing at i; 75.5% of eligible rows in the census)
econ.rule: primary paper rule: L == 0 and |x| >= 0.05: take the side against x at the origin touch, exit at the j touch, taker fee both legs. Descriptive companion: L >= liquid_cut (upper tercile of L > 0) and |x| >= 0.05, follow x

flow.x6: clip(sum(sign * size * price) / sum(size * price), -1, 1) / 0.8578 over trades with t - 6 h <= ts < t (t = origin row receipt); NaN if the 6 h window is not covered by the 500-trade page or has no trade
flow.rv: rms of consecutive-slot two-sided mid differences over slots k-12..k (series files); log(rv + 1e-4)

econ.rule: favourable (upper) moderator tercile (log rv >= cut for F4; spread >= 0.03 - 1e-9 for F5) and |imb6| >= 0.5: follow sign(imb6) at the origin touch, exit at the 6 h target touch, taker fee both legs

e014.source: data-dumps/research_lab/e007/dev_fit.json (E007 frozen development fit; host copy read 2026-10-19)
e014.signed_share: signed_volume_1h / volume_1h from the trade sample's features.csv.gz (0 if volume_1h = 0), E007 definition
e014.regimes: as-of hours to end = (Gamma end_date at the origin capture - origin receipt) / 3600; A: (0, 24], B: > 720, P: <= 0 (past nominal end, excluded), M: between (excluded), U: unknown (excluded)

econ.rule: regime A, |signed_share| = 1 and n_trades_1h >= 3: follow sign(signed_share) at the origin touch, exit at the 2 h target touch, taker fee both legs
